entries.en: And when we do, we can't make head or tail of each other.
entries.ro: Și când vorbim, nu ne pricepem deloc.

entries.en: Is there something strange in the way I speak?
Strange? Nooo... You sound just like the rest of us.
entries.ro: Ciudat? Nuuu... Vorbești ca toți ceilalți.

entries.en: We don't ride to the city enough.
